proof_body:
by
  intro n r α z hn hr
  have hE : ∀ t : ℝ, (Real.cos t : ℂ) + (Real.sin t : ℂ) * Complex.I = Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro t
    rw [Complex.exp_mul_I]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := hn.ne'
  have hnC : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  have hrC : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr.ne'
  simp only [hE]
  have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, ((r : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((((α + 2 * k * Real.pi) / n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ n = ((r ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro k
    rw [mul_pow, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    have : (n : ℂ) * ((((α + 2 * k * Real.pi) / n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = (α : ℂ) * Complex.I + k * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) := by
      push_cast
      field_simp
    rw [this, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_nat_mul, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, one_pow, mul_one]
    push_cast
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro h
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn0⟩
    set w₀ : ℂ := (r : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((α / n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) with hw₀
    have hw₀ne : w₀ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hrC (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
    have hw₀pow : w₀ ^ n = ((r ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      have := hpow 0
      simpa [hw₀] using this
    have hu : (z / w₀) ^ n = 1 := by
      rw [div_pow, h, hw₀pow, div_self]
      exact mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (pow_ne_zero n hr.ne')) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkeq⟩ := (Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp n hn0).eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hu
    refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    have hz : z = w₀ * Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / n) ^ k := by
      rw [hkeq]; field_simp
    rw [hz, hw₀, mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    field_simp
  · rintro ⟨k, _, rfl⟩
    exact hpow k
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r α : ℝ) (z : ℂ), 0 < n → 0 < r → (z ^ n = ((r ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.cos α : ℂ) + (Real.sin α : ℂ) * Complex.I) ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, k < n ∧ z = (r : ℂ) * ((Real.cos ((α + 2 * k * Real.pi) / n) : ℂ) + (Real.sin ((α + 2 * k * Real.pi) / n) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
